content_sections.heading: BARC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download BARC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.Sc. in Biological Science with minimum 60%; one year experience in BSL-3 Lab Experience: One year experience in working in BSL-3 Lab is essential Age limit: Maximum 50 years (as on 30 June 2026) Other conditions: Selected candidates must obtain a medical certificate from a Registered Medical Practitioner.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for BARC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates whose completed application forms are not submitted before 12:45 hrs will not be interviewed.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Locum/adhoc temporary post Period of appointment not more than 89 days at one time (maximum 2 terms)

content_sections.heading: How Will BARC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview If more than 15 candidates have the required experience, candidates for interview will be chosen by highest percentage of marks in B.Sc. (Final) and work experience.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Original certificates of date of birth and educational qualification (Class X, XII, B.Sc. year-wise mark sheets, degree/passing/convocation certificate) One set of attested xerox copies of certificates One passport size photograph

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BARC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Report at the venue on 05-11-2026 between 12:00 and 12:30 hrs to collect the application form. Submit the filled application form with attached xerox copies and photographs before 12:45 hrs. Bring original certificates with one set of attested xerox copies and one passport size photograph.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No application forms will be distributed after 12:30 hrs. Interview is at 14:00 hrs.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for BARC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in BARC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Scientific Assistant/B.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for BARC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 5 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Conference Room No. 1, Ground Floor, Behind BARC Hospital Library, BARC Hospital, Anushaktinagar, Mumbai.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 50 years (as on 30 June 2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: ₹19,502 per month + D.A. (pre-revised).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.Sc. in Biological Science with minimum 60%; one year experience in BSL-3 Lab essential.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates must obtain a medical certificate from a Registered Medical Practitioner.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates whose completed application forms are not submitted before 12:45 hrs will not be interviewed.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. If more than 15 candidates have the required experience, candidates for interview will be chosen by highest percentage of marks in B.Sc. (Final) and work experience.
